vision.notes: The still shows the settled reveal: the header reads "Použité pokusy: 2 ze 2". Part a ("3,5") is locked in teal with a check and "Správně". Part b sits in a neutral dashed read-only field with an eye icon, and below it "Tvoje odpověď: 7,2  Správná odpověď: 7". A beige panel says "Nevadí, příště! Tady jsou správné odpovědi." Nothing is red and nothing says "Špatně" or "Chyba". The text is legible against its backgrounds; the smallest is the grey "Tvoje odpověď / Správná odpověď" line, which is small but still looks AA. One minor point: rounding 7,04 to tenths would usually be shown as "7,0", not "7".

The muted look of the disabled hint button is expected for a disabled control.
